text:
maria_ae: Heads-up — Acme returned the MSA+DPA with redlines and a PO attached. They want signature + SOC2 before releasing the initial payment. PO requests net60.
lee_csm: Do they specify Hosted vs Dedicated for the POC? That affects SLA and key management.
rachel_acme: POC will be Hosted in EU region only. We noted desire for customer-managed keys eventually but ok to start with hosted-managed for trial.
amy_legal: Upload the redline here so I can review. My initial read: they tightened data access/audit, asked to remove liability cap, and bumped SLA to 99.95.
maria_ae: Upload: https://drive.google.com/acme/procurement/redline_v2.pdf
tom_revops: Billing notes: PO number present, billing contact finance@acme.com, they put net60. Our standard is net30; revenue ok with net45 but net60 needs approval. Who's routing for signatures?
oliver_se: From an ops perspective, hosted EU-only is fine for the POC if we restrict replication and set region tags. Throughput caps in PO look higher than POC scope, will flag.
amy_legal: Proposed concession: for Hosted POC, agree to 99.9% SLA. For Dedicated/Prod we can discuss 99.95 SLA in production contract. Liability cap: propose cap = greater of $1M or 2x fees for first year, revisit on renewal. DPA/KMS: hosted = managed keys with contractual safeguards; include pathway to CMK on Dedicated.
maria_ae: Acme counsel pushed back hard on liability and KMS. They say KMS is a must for their procurement team.
lee_csm: Is KMS a deal-breaker for POC? If yes, we need to propose Dedicated trial nodes which is more expensive and slower to provision.
tom_revops: Financial ops: if we accept net60, we need signed approval from VP Sales. Also require PO to be attached to DocuSign.
amy_legal: Suggest we offer temporary compromise: temporary hosted-managed keys + signed DPA commitments, with contractual migration timeline to CMK if they go to prod. Also tighten audit language to limit scope.
rachel_acme: Their procurement says they cannot approve without CMK language in contract. Is a migration path acceptable?
maria_ae: I'll ask procurement for a 7-day exception to proceed with POC under managed keys while contract gets updated.
oliver_se: If they accept short-term managed keys, engineering can enable EU-only tenancy and limit token caps for the POC.
esign-bot: Envelope created by maria_ae. Signing order: rachel_acme (Legal) -> rachel_acme (Finance) -> maria_ae (AE) -> amy_legal (Redwood Legal) -> tom_revops (Finance). Link: https://docusign.net/envelope/xyz123
tom_revops: If we get the VP sign-off on net60, we'll take it. Maria, can you escalate to VP?
maria_ae: Escalating now. I'll also attach a brief SOW addendum clarifying POC scope and migration path to CMK.
rachel_acme: We can try the 7-day exception. Legal will review the redline with your proposed CMK migration language.
amy_legal: I'll add a redline with specific migration milestones (30/60/90 days to transition to CMK for production), plus indemnity narrowed to IP infringement and willful misconduct.
lee_csm: Once signatures are done, I’ll open an onboarding ticket for engineering and request SOC2 upload to their portal.
maria_ae: Thanks — tracking this thread as the procurement/signature thread. Targeting signatures in 48 hours if VP approves net60.
rachel_acme: Thanks team. Well confirm on our side tonight. :thumbsup:
amy_legal: Noted. Leaving comments on the PDF and sending back to their counsel.
